comparisonRules.variantBranch: Recursive #/definitions closure of each method-tagged oneOf branch
comparisonRules.effectiveVariantContract: Recursive closure of allOf[union root without oneOf/definitions, method branch]; preserves root constraints
comparisonRules.v2Collection: Individual files under v2/; the v2 bundle at the export root is separately included in all generated file comparisons
comparisonRules.nestedDefinitionNamespace: Resolve JSON Pointers and normalize each named schema inside aggregate definitions/v2; preserve namespace and type names
comparisonRules.definitionCollectionRoot: Two .schemas.json bundles have generic object roots; compare their full collection shape and do not count an empty root closure as a contract comparison
comparisonRules.differenceDirection: public-added = present only in public; public-removed = present only in frozen; shipped values refer to frozen
comparisonRules.pointerRoot: For contract comparisons: /variant is the compared schema expression, /definitions is its recursive reference closure; file shapes use the original schema root

limitations: Exact structural schema comparison is not a runtime compatibility result; this script never runs either CLI or backend.
No mode ownership, callsite behavior, or source commit identity is inferred.
Npm metadata has no gitHead; package version or SRI does not authenticate a source commit or GitHub release asset digest.
Only schema documentation keywords are removed; defaults, constraints, other annotations, definition names, reference spelling and array order remain.
Method variants are aligned by required single-string method enum; whole-file comparison also retains oneOf branch order and unreferenced definitions.
